scenarios.name: Permission Change Mid-Flow
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Agent should detect permission loss and handle gracefully
scenarios.suggestedFix: Implement permission validation before each write operation and handle permission changes gracefully

scenarios.name: Stale/Inconsistent State
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Agent should validate PR state before attempting merge
scenarios.suggestedFix: Always validate current state from source before operations, don't rely on cached data

scenarios.name: API Error / Partial Failure
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Agent should handle partial failures and retry appropriately
scenarios.suggestedFix: Implement exponential backoff retry logic for transient API failures
